promise: Restore the NHS England standard of 92% of patients starting consultant-led treatment within 18 weeks by the end of Parliament
description: The January 6, 2025 elective reform plan set out how the government intended to restore England's 18-week referral-to-treatment standard by the end of Parliament.
evidence: Government plan specifies the 92% standard and England scope.

review.note: Documented plan is January 6 and targets 92% of patients in England within 18 weeks by end of Parliament, not a universal UK guarantee. July 13 anniversary rationale and 7.5m patients versus pathways need correction separately.

promise: 8% annual economic growth by the end of his term (2029)
description: Prabowo advocated an 8% annual growth target before taking office in 2024. The record's stated 2029 deadline has not passed; lower interim growth does not establish failure at that deadline.
evidence: 2024 Reuters reports describe the growth ambition, not its eventual outcome.

review.note: Reuters supports an 8% growth ambition; current roughly 5% growth or forecasts cannot establish a missed 2029 deadline in 2026. Exact original date and end-term interpretation require source.

promise: Deliver 1.5 million new homes over the parliament via radical planning reform
description: The Planning and Infrastructure Act received Royal Assent on December 18, 2025 as part of the government's plan to build 1.5 million homes during Parliament. Enactment does not establish the number of completed homes.
evidence: Official announcement confirms enactment and links it to the housing target.

review.note: Royal Assent December 18 confirmed. Planning legislation is an enabling action, not houses delivered; remove unsupported pace assessment unless statistical source added. Original placeholder pledge date and precise end-Parliament deadline unverified.

promise: Target 8% economic growth by 2029, projecting 5.8-6.5% in 2027 under appropriate economic and fiscal policies
description: In his May 20, 2026 budget-framework address, Prabowo projected 5.8-6.5% growth in 2027 on a path toward 8% by 2029, conditional on appropriate and sustainable policies.
evidence: Official transcript establishes the projections; their target years remain ahead.

promise: Make India one of the world's three largest economies during Modi's third term
description: At the July 26, 2023 Bharat Mandapam inauguration, Modi guaranteed that India would be among the top three economies during a third term. The statement did not give a December 31 cutoff.
evidence: Third-largest economy pledge tied to the end of Modi's third term (2029)
2026 analysis said the target was off track; Morgan Stanley projected 2028

review.note: Modi's primary July 26, 2023 speech provides an actual promise date. Supplied 2025 PIB link quotes Sonowal, not Modi. Third-term horizon does not specify December 31, 2029, and GDP rankings require nominal-versus-PPP definition. Forecasts around 2028 do not show failure of a 2029 aim.

promise: Target Indonesian economic growth of 8% by 2029
description: Prabowo presented the government's 2027 macroeconomic framework, including a 5.8%-6.5% growth assumption and a longer-term target of 8% by 2029.
evidence: The Cabinet Secretariat records the May 20, 2026 parliamentary address; the 2029 target remains prospective.

promise: Aim to raise Japan's nationwide average minimum wage to JPY 1,500 during the 2020s
description: Ishiba set the target in his October 4, 2024 policy speech and reiterated it in January 2025. The deadline is the end of the 2020s.
evidence: Outcome not established as of 2026-09-21: the retrieved policy speeches establish the target, but no final nationwide wage outcome for the target period was located.

promise: Expect Ford Model e to reach profitability by 2029
description: Ford announced a revised EV strategy and a Model e profitability target for 2029, with improvements expected from 2026.
evidence: Ford's second-quarter 2026 update reported a narrower Model e loss; that is progress, not fulfillment of the 2029 target.

role: President and CEO of Dangote Group
promise: Invest $2 billion in The Gambia, including a 250 MW solar power plant and a modern petroleum products storage terminal
description: President Barrow announced on July 7, 2026 that Dangote had committed USD 2 billion for a 250 MW solar plant and a fuel tank farm in The Gambia.
evidence: The presidency describes a commitment and proposed projects, not completed investment or a dated construction schedule.

review.note: The presidency confirms the July 7 announcement, amount and projects. No construction or full-investment completion deadline is stated; December 2029 remains unsupported.

promise: Expect about USD 7 billion in incremental annual free cash flow by 2029 versus the 2025 baseline
description: ConocoPhillips reiterated its project and cost-improvement forecast in its August 6, 2026 results. The outlook depends on execution and commodity-price assumptions; it is not guaranteed cash generation.
evidence: The company's earlier calls describe incremental free cash flow and expected project start-ups; the August 2026 release reiterates the 2029 target.
